season.evidence: Web search: guide pages and trip reports put the dry, snow-free window at summer; late June can still hold snow and winter needs avalanche skills; stored text agrees. Logged successes peak Jul-Sep (79/104/61).

track.why: Only one route is stored on this peak; the Aug 30 track starts at the Hurricane Ridge lot (199 m from our trailhead pin), follows the ridge trail to the climbers path and reaches the summit within 6 m. Logged as the Hurricane Ridge trail, Class 3 scramble.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 2025 Standard, fits but sparser (719 pts); 3329635 denser and more recent
Switchback + East Ridge, start 3.4 km from our pin
Oct 4, start far from our pin, not complete

facts.text: Near the top many boot paths braid together; in late August keeping to the left at the forks led to the easiest line.
Taking the wrong chute just below the summit in late September forced a downclimb; in fog (late August) the scramble felt more exposed than its Class 3 rating.

notes: Single route on peak. Summit pin matches Peakbagger exactly. Several harvested tracks are winter ascents (excluded).
